"""Write moon with nine broad-edge pen strokes and save an open-loop replay."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

OUT=Path('/app/output')
# Image-space cubic centerlines, fitted to the public exemplar.
PARAMS={
'm':[332.43245052938124,481.62539742668923,556.5706866372522,321.7683511674307,491.1097203131814,40.57982865656946,15.746456835996833,17.942434637218632,22.51520282676212,1.3574303291794383,1.5880003190735363,-22.209730789168294,-0.2702565678392311,11.04138594379815,-0.17154286815977415,4.940200494278904],
'o1':[482.9213175277161,521.1297484702404,35.43356771585572,35.77163593210726,20.422930676676447,20.572193980590743,21.941725837005478,19.699497539528767,-0.2426725375424103,0.05283435681499259,-0.19504682916647176,0.6507014895553068],
'o2':[576.5095025305212,521.151422848979,35.375182275146614,35.68427028398731,20.689622617745464,19.629861541087156,21.958444385109793,20.63344375014968,0.5084864884247133,0.21880605238300826,-0.8364053637352842,0.03548839049276106],
'n':[642.857357681373,482.44724306855403,556.5876655906953,629.7854257931514,492.27942701567343,45.01779477518854,20.76504022627157,10.955905467505307,22.169965194472834,0.2587768448648642,0.37173332682022425,-23.854499562906827,-0.21751380060532113,13.0,0.09349715188325489,-12.0]}

def bez(p,n=101):
    t=np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None];p=np.asarray(p)
    return (1-t)**3*p[0]+3*(1-t)**2*t*p[1]+3*(1-t)*t*t*p[2]+t**3*p[3]

def humps(v,count):
    x,y,base,serx,sery,aw,dx,dy,c1x,c1y,c2x,c2y,s1x,s1y,s2x,s2y=v
    paths=[np.array([[serx,sery],[x,y],[x,base]])]
    for j in range(count):
        a=np.array([x+j*aw,y+dy]);b=np.array([x+j*aw+dx,y+1.5]);end=np.array([x+(j+1)*aw,y+37])
        first=np.linspace(a,b,20)
        curve=bez([b,b+[c1x,c1y],end+[c2x,c2y],end])
        last=bez([end,end+[s1x,s1y],[x+(j+1)*aw+s2x,base+s2y],[x+(j+1)*aw,base]])
        paths.append(np.vstack([first,curve[1:],last[1:]]))
    return paths

def oval(v):
    x,y,rx,ry,k1,k2,k3,k4,tx,bx,ly,rry=v
    top=np.array([x+tx,y-ry]);right=np.array([x+rx,y+rry]);bottom=np.array([x+bx,y+ry]);left=np.array([x-rx,y+ly])
    a=bez([top,top+[-k1,0],left+[0,-k2],left]);b=bez([left,left+[0,k3],bottom+[-k4,0],bottom])
    c=bez([top,top+[k1,0],right+[0,-k2],right]);d=bez([right,right+[0,k3],bottom+[k4,0],bottom])
    return [np.vstack([a,b[1:]]),np.vstack([c,d[1:]])]

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    quat=s.tip_down_quat(np.pi/6)
    def move(pos,speed=.04,settle=8):
        info=p['move_tip'](pos,quat,speed=speed,settle=settle)
        if info['ik_failures']: raise RuntimeError(info)
    move([-.1,.15,.07]);move([-.1,.15,.025],speed=.02);move([-.1,.15,.055])
    paths=humps(PARAMS['m'],2)+oval(PARAMS['o1'])+oval(PARAMS['o2'])+humps(PARAMS['n'],1)
    px_m=s.geo.px_m
    def pos(uv,z):
        return np.array([s.geo.x_far-(uv[1]+.5)*px_m,s.geo.y_left-(uv[0]+.5)*px_m,z])
    for i,path in enumerate(paths):
        move(pos(path[0],.04),speed=.05)
        move(pos(path[0],.018),speed=.015,settle=12)
        # Constant arc-length sampling at 3 mm/s (20 Hz targets).
        for j in range(len(path)-1):
            length=np.linalg.norm(path[j+1]-path[j])*px_m
            n=max(1,int(np.ceil(length/.00015)))
            for k in range(1,n+1):
                uv=path[j]+(path[j+1]-path[j])*k/n
                q,ok,err=s.ik(pos(uv,.018),quat)
                if not ok: raise RuntimeError(('writing IK',i,err))
                s.step(q)
            if len(path)==3 and j==0:p['hold'](5)
        p['hold'](12)
        move(pos(path[-1],.04),speed=.015,settle=8)
        print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'canvas.png')
    np.save(OUT/'ink.npy',s.ink())
    np.savez(OUT/'samples.npz',**{f'p{i}':np.array(st['samples']) for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes()) if st['inked'] and st['sheet']=='main'})
    print('saved',len(actions),'actions',flush=True)
    status=s.status();print(json.dumps(status,indent=2),flush=True)
    (OUT/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
